lines.text: ช่วย ด้วย
น้ำ มา
Cold. Something pulling at me. Someone is shouting, far away.
ปลา
Warm. Dry. A roof over me. My head is pounding.
I can't remember anything. Not even my own name.
There's a scrap of paper in my pocket, soaked through. A ferry ticket. The ink has run so badly I can't read where it was going.
คุณ ตื่น แล้ว
Her words slide right past me. I can't hold on to a single sound.
ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร
She mimes putting food in her mouth, then points at me. Slowly this time.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
She hands me a bowl of rice. It's still warm.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่ หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร
She leaves a bowl of rice beside me anyway.
She sits down across from me and points at herself.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ
One sound at a time.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มะลิ
She points at herself again, and waits for me.

reactions.text: ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ

lines.text: Her mouth twitches. She shakes her head, taps her own chest, then mine.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มะลิ
Just her name, then. I say it back and she nods.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ใช่

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร
I open my mouth and nothing comes. There's nothing there to say.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ จำ ไม่ ได้
She says it softly, like she's guessed something.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ตื่น แล้ว

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
The noise is starting to come apart into words. Maybe she'll tell me what other things are called.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อย่า ไป ข้างนอก
Her voice is quiet, but she means it.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ จำ ได้ ไหม
Mali puts a plate of rice and fish in front of me. Lunch.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
Before I can start, she presses her palms together and bows her head a little. She says it slowly, like it matters.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ
Then she points at me and says it again, but it ends differently.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ครับ
She waits.

tiles.answer: ขอบคุณ ครับ

reactions.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ

lines.text: Mali covers her mouth with her hand, but I can see she's laughing.
She taps her own chest.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ค่ะ
Then mine.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ครับ
One more time, then.

tiles.answer: ขอบคุณ ครับ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร ค่ะ
She just nods and starts eating.
She almost smiles before she catches herself.
Someone bangs on the door. A man's voice, rough and cheerful, calling from the yard.
I hold out Lung Daeng's hundred baht note to Mali.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อะไร
She wants to know where I got it.

tiles.prompt: Tell her you worked for it
accept: ผม ทำงาน ครับ

reactions.text: ฉัน ทำงาน

lines.text: Her eyebrows go up. She taps my chest, the way Lung Daeng did.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ผม
Right. Again.

tiles.prompt: Tell her you worked for it
accept: ผม ทำงาน ครับ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
She's fed me for two days. She's the reason I'm not in the sea.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ
The first time she's said it to me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ
She says it short and flat, and tucks the note away quickly.
I put it back in my pocket. She doesn't say anything. She doesn't need to.
I hum it under my breath. Across the room, Mali goes very still.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เพลง นี้
She's staring at me like she's trying to place my face.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไป นอน
She turns the lamp down without another word.
I hold the school photo out to her and point at the scratched face.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ใคร
Her voice is sharp, like I've done something wrong.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ฉัน ไม่ รู้
She says it too fast. Her thumb is resting on the scratched-out face.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เอา มา
She takes it from me and puts it face down on the shelf.
Something changes in her face. Like a door swinging shut.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ เป็น ใคร
She looks at me like I'm a stranger again. Like she's never seen me before.
Mali sets a cup of water down beside me without a word.
When I look up she's already turned away. But she left it there.
An old man in a faded red cap, grease up to his elbows. He grins at me like we've met before.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: มา ช่วย หน่อย
He jerks his thumb at the yard. A generator, half buried in wet sand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: เติม น้ำมัน
He unscrews a cap on the generator and nods at the red can by my feet.

choices.text: Pour the can into the generator

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ไม่ ไม่
He laughs and taps the red can.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: น้ำมัน
The can, then. It smells like petrol.
We lift the generator onto a cart. He takes the front and waits for me to steer.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ซ้าย
The wheel sinks into the sand. He grabs my left hand and waggles it.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ซ้าย
A fallen palm blocks the path to the house.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ขวา
We bump straight into the palm. He slaps my right arm, not too hard.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ขวา
He puts the starter cord in my hand and holds up his fingers, one at a time.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
The cord snaps back and nearly takes my fingers with it. He shakes his head and counts again.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
On the last one this time.
The engine coughs, catches and roars. Sparks spit from a loose wire right next to my hand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ระวัง
A jolt of pain runs up my arm. He yanks me back by the collar.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ระวัง
I won't forget that word.
Inside, the lights flicker on. I hear Mali laugh in surprise.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
He pulls a crumpled note from his pocket and presses it into my hand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ร้อย บาท

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร

choices.text: ฉัน จำ ไม่ ได้

lines.text: He bursts out laughing and slaps his knee.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม
He thumps his own chest, then mine, and says it again with my words.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม จำ ไม่ ได้
So I've been talking like Mali this whole time. Of course I have. She's the only one who's taught me anything.
He shrugs back, twice as big, then thumps his chest and points at the generator.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม ทำงาน
Then he points at me.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: คุณ ทำงาน ดี
Lung Daeng has a little radio on the step, turned up loud. A woman is reading the news, fast.

lines.speaker: วิทยุ
lines.text: เมื่อคืน เรือ โดยสาร ล่ม กลาง ทะเล มี คน หาย หลาย คน
Lung Daeng switches it off. He doesn't look at me.
My hand goes to the soaked ticket in my pocket.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
He's sitting on the step, poking at the generator with a screwdriver.
เตียง
The sheets are still warm. I must have slept here.
หน้าต่าง
The yard outside is a mess of broken boards and seaweed. A little spirit house lies on its side in the mud.
Mali comes to stand beside me and points at an upturned hull, wedged against the fence.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เรือ
She looks at it for a long time before she turns away.
กระจก
A stranger looks back at me. Someone has cleaned the cut over my eye and taped it shut.
ประตู
It's barred from the inside with a plank. Through the gap I can hear the sea, much too close.
My hand is on the plank when I feel Mali watching me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อย่า
Just that one word, cold enough that I let go.
โต๊ะ
A low table. Two bowls, two spoons. She was expecting me to wake up.
น้ำ
A clay jar full of rainwater. The tap water must be gone.
ตะเกียง
An oil lamp. With the power out, it's all the light there is.
The flame gutters. A tune comes into my head from nowhere. Something slow, for falling asleep to.
หนังสือ
Rows of old books, swollen with damp. I can't read a single title.
Tucked between two books, a school photo. Rows of children in white shirts, squinting into the sun.
One face has been scratched out with something sharp.
The girl next to it has Mali's eyes.
ปฏิทิน
Someone has been crossing off the days. Further on, one date is circled in red, with a full moon and a little lotus-shaped float drawn beside it.
เสื้อ
My own clothes, hung up to dry, still stiff with salt. The ones I'm wearing are borrowed. They're a man's, and they almost fit.
รูป
A little shrine on a cliff over the sea, under a full moon. It's the only thing in the room the water didn't touch.
แมว
เหมียว
It pads straight over and leans against my leg, like it always does.
Mali crouches by the table with a saucer of rice and calls across the room, quick and sing-song.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มา นี่ แมว น้อย มา กิน ข้าว
The cat ignores her completely and stays with me. Mali gives it a betrayed look.
